COURTHOUSE PLANS (UPDATED 05/06/25) ADDRESS CHANGE Sheriff's Department Online Tools view All News ABOUT US slide 1 of 1 About Hall County: Hall County is situated along Interstate 80 in scenic central Nebraska. We believe that Hall County provides the right balance of city and country living. With Grand Island being Nebraska's fourth-largest city, we have easy access to the services of a larger city while also enjoying the abundant natural resources that living in the country in Nebraska's Platte Valley provides.
